title: Intuitive Controls and Technology
summary: Feedback centers on whether the G70’s controls and in-car technology feel intuitive, with most examples praising overall ease of use while a few mention less convenient touchscreen or door-control interactions.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the technology and overall control layout feel intuitive, though some favorable examples still mention specific controls that could be easier to use.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback says the vehicle feels behind because it lacks technology and intuitive controls in some areas.

limitations: Several fragments labeled positive contain critical wording about controls being less intuitive, so sentiment labels and quoted wording are somewhat misaligned.
The sample is small and mixes broad impressions of intuitiveness with specific complaints about touchscreen navigation and door-open controls.
All examples are from US G70 reviews, so no broader market or model comparison is supported.
